```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(glycoverse)
library(glydb)
library(lobstr)
library(ggimage)
library(microbenchmark)
```

```{r}
#| label: memory-usage

base_structures <- glydb_structures()[1:100]

n_rows <- seq(100, 2000, by = 400)

measure_memory <- function(n) {
  # Scenario A: New implementation (vctrs)
  idx <- sample(100, n, replace = TRUE)
  vctrs_obj <- base_structures[idx] 

  # Scenario B: Naive List
  naive_list <- lapply(idx, function(i) {
    rlang::duplicate(base_structures[[i]]) 
  })

  tibble(
    n = n,
    `Optimized` = obj_size(vctrs_obj),
    `Naive List` = obj_size(naive_list)
  )
}

plot_data <- map_dfr(n_rows, measure_memory) |>
  pivot_longer(-n, names_to = "Implementation", values_to = "Size") |>
  mutate(Size = Size / 1024^2) # Convert to MB

p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = n, y = Size, color = Implementation)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Memory Usage",
    x = "Number of Structures",
    y = "Memory Usage (MB)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
ggpreview(plot = p1, width = 5, height = 4)
```

```{r}
#| label: performance-benchmark

# Here we only benchmark the performance of currect implementation,
# using three functions: `glymotif::have_motif()`, `glyrepr::convert_to_generic()`, `glydet::n_glycan_type()`.

base_structures <- glydb_structures()
motif_pattern <- "HexNAc(??-"
bench_sizes <- 1:10 * 10

if (length(base_structures) < max(bench_sizes)) {
  stop("Not enough unique structures in glydb_structures() for the chosen bench_sizes.")
}

make_all_unique <- function(n) {
  base_structures[seq_len(n)]
}

make_repeat_10 <- function(n) {
  pool <- base_structures[seq_len(10)]
  rep(pool, length.out = n)
}

# Warm up to avoid measuring lazy-load/compile overhead; fix threads for stability
Sys.setenv(
  OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1,
  MKL_NUM_THREADS = 1,
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = 1,
  VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = 1
)

bench_one <- function(structures, scenario, n = 10L) {
  invisible(glymotif::have_motif(structures, motif_pattern, ignore_linkages = TRUE))

  microbenchmark(
    `have_motif()` = glymotif::have_motif(structures, motif_pattern, ignore_linkages = TRUE),
    times = n
  ) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    summarise(median_ms = median(time) / 1e6, .by = expr) |>
    mutate(
      n = length(structures),
      scenario = scenario
    )
}

perf_data <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(bench_sizes, ~ make_all_unique(.x) |> bench_one("Native list", n = 1)),
  map_dfr(bench_sizes, ~ make_repeat_10(.x) |> bench_one("Optimized", n = 1))
)

p2 <- perf_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = median_ms, color = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "have_motif() Runtime",
    x = "Number of Structures",
    y = "Median Runtime (ms)",
    color = "Implementation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
ggpreview(plot = p2, width = 5, height = 4)
```

```{r}
#| label: patchwork

library(patchwork)

combined <- p1 + p2 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
ggpreview(plot = combined, width = 10, height = 4)
ggsave("results/figures/perf_benchmark.pdf", combined, width = 10, height = 4)
```
